name: Petka
source: Getting busted together for smoking in the university bathroom blossomed into a wonderful friendship — despite Petka being entirely to blame and Grisha merely being in the wrong place at the wrong time. A bundle of energy, Petka frequents the local Moonbucks to demand free coffee during Grisha’s shifts. He is surprisingly good at math and often helps Grisha pass his exams. Petka is worried about his dear friend’s social and general well-being and, usually to much protest, tries to drag him to parties and introduce him to girls.
